summary: Ellington Financial Inc. filed an 8-K on July 8, 2026, announcing a monthly common dividend of $0.13 per share declared by its Board of Directors, payable August 31, 2026 to holders of record July 31, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation such as capital returns (e.g., special dividend, buyback), restructuring, or any other categorized event. The filing includes no M&A, activist, tender offer, or strategic review content. The registrant is the issuer of common stock. The event lacks triggerable conditions, premiums, or structural complications, making it an ordinary course disclosure.
